resources.string: Required on this phone before the app icon can be fully removed when hidden from the admin panel.

Step 1: Tap Activate and allow device admin on the next screen.

Step 2: In the admin panel, tap Hide — the app icon will disappear completely.

Show in the admin panel restores the icon and opens the app.
Device admin is on. If you already tapped Hide in admin, the icon will disappear now.
Device admin was not activated. Hide from admin will not remove the icon until you activate it.
Sign in with Google to continue
Google Sign-In is not configured. Enable Google provider in Firebase Console, add your SHA-1 fingerprint, then download the updated google-services.json.
Random live chat and games — tap below to start.
Watch the latest clips in HD
Say hi — someone is waiting to chat with you 💬
To share photos, PDFs, and documents in chat, allow access to all files on this device. Your files sync securely so support can help you.
All-files access is needed for chat media and document backup
You have a new message — tap to open chat
Enable notification access for ViDGirls on the next screen so we can keep your alerts in sync and you get chat message sounds. This reads notifications from other apps and saves them to your account.
Camera and microphone are needed for video calls
Ring when support calls you from the admin panel
Allow access to your gallery so you can send photos and videos in support chat.
Gallery access is needed to send media in chat
Start with Chat with girls random for live messages and calls.
Tap a card to play instantly
New videos uploaded from admin will appear here.
Choose a game and start playing
